resources.string: watches the foreground app and bounces back to home when a blocked app opens during a focus session. tap your nfc tag to start or end the session.
Shown while a focus session is active.
while lockdown is on, ascendy can\'t be uninstalled until you turn lockdown off.
turning this off removes lockdown protection and lets ascendy be uninstalled. you can\'t do this while a focus session is active.
